sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was raised materially: Q1 2026 revenue guided to about $9.8B, ahead of the roughly $9.4B consensus, and management pointed to significant top and bottom line growth in 2026. The Q4 results beat expectations with revenue of $10.3B versus consensus of about $9.7B, and data center revenue accelerated to 39% growth. While China GPU sales are called highly uncertain and semi-custom gaming revenue is expected to decline, these risks are secondary to the strong beat and raise.

summary.revenue: Q4 revenue $10.3B, up 34% year over year and 11% sequentially. Full-year revenue $34.6B, up 34%.
summary.guidance: Q1 2026 revenue guided to about $9.8B plus or minus $300M, ahead of the roughly $9.4B consensus, including only $100M of China MI308. Management pointed to significant top and bottom line growth in 2026.
summary.margin: Gross margin 57%, up 290bps year over year.
key_risks: China GPU sales called highly uncertain, with only $100M assumed and no further guidance.
Semi-custom gaming revenue expected to decline a significant double-digit percentage in 2026.
PC headwinds from memory and component inflation, with the second half modeled subseasonal.
key_opportunities: Customer pull for Venice is very high with engagements underway.
The vast majority going to be RackScale solutions.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management pointed to significant top and bottom line growth in 2026 and described customer pull for Venice as very high, indicating strong forward confidence.
